prompt: Perform a 3-way reconciliation between Purchase Order PO-SIE-2026-901, Goods Receipt Note GRN-SIE-901, and Vendor Invoice INV-SIE-8819 for Siemens Sinamics S120 Drive Converters: PO-SIE-2026-901 authorizes 10 units @ €4,500.00 each (Net €45,000.00 + 19% German UStG VAT €8,550.00 = Total €53,550.00; Payment Terms: 2% cash discount (Skonto) if settled within 14 days, net 30). GRN-SIE-901 confirms 10 units received in factory packaging and passed cold-commissioning inspection on Nov 10, 2026. Vendor Invoice INV-SIE-8819 dated Nov 12, 2026 claims €53,550.00. Processing date is Nov 18, 2026 (Day 6 of 14-day discount window). Reconcile the ledger and determine exact payable disbursement.
chosen: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: MATCHED WITH EARLY PAYMENT DISCOUNT (SKONTO APPLIED). Line item quantity (10 units), unit base price (€4,500.00), and statutory German VAT rate (19% / €8,550.00) tie out perfectly across PO-SIE-2026-901, GRN-SIE-901, and Invoice INV-SIE-8819. Because disbursement occurs on Day 6 (within the 14-day Skonto window under German UStG §17 Abs. 1), the 2% early payment discount applies to the net base amount: Discount = €45,000.00 x 2% = €900.00. Reduced Net Base = €44,100.00. Adjusted 19% VAT = €44,100.00 x 19% = €8,379.00 (VAT reduction: €171.00). Total Net Disbursement = €52,479.00. Post journal voucher: Dr Accounts Payable €53,550.00, Cr Bank €52,479.00, Cr Cash Discount Received €900.00, Cr Input VAT Adjustment €171.00.
rejected: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: MATCHED / PAY IN FULL. The 3-way match is clean because 10 units were authorized on PO-SIE-2026-901, 10 units were received on GRN-SIE-901, and the vendor invoice INV-SIE-8819 accurately bills €45,000.00 plus 19% VAT for €53,550.00. Authorize immediate wire transfer of €53,550.00. Skonto cash discount should be recorded as miscellaneous treasury income after the full invoice clears the general ledger at day 30.

prompt: Audit 3-way match for Schneider Electric Masterpact MTZ Circuit Breakers under PO-SCH-2026-402, Delivery Docket DD-SCH-402, and Invoice INV-SCH-1092: PO agreed on 4 units @ $12,500.00/unit Incoterms DDP Chicago warehouse ($50,000.00 lump sum including freight and import duty). DD-SCH-402 confirms 4 units delivered undamaged. Vendor Invoice INV-SCH-1092 itemizes 4 units @ $12,500.00 ($50,000.00) plus an added line item 'Ocean Freight Bunker Surcharge & Chicago Port Handling' for $2,840.00, totaling $52,840.00. Reconcile the discrepancy under Incoterms 2020 rules.
chosen: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: DISCREPANCY / REJECT UNAPPROVED FREIGHT SURCHARGE ($2,840.00). Under Incoterms 2020 DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), the seller bears all risks, ocean freight, bunker adjustments, import duties, and port handling charges until the goods are placed at the buyer's disposal at the specified destination (Chicago warehouse). PO-SCH-2026-402 specifies DDP at $12,500.00/unit all-inclusive. Schneider Electric cannot unilaterally bill ancillary freight or demurrage. Approved Payable = $50,000.00. Issue a formal Price Discrepancy Debit Note for $2,840.00 and release $50,000.00 against Delivery Docket DD-SCH-402.
rejected: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: APPROVED WITHIN STANDARD LOGISTICS SURCHARGE TOLERANCE. The core delivery of 4 circuit breakers matches PO-SCH-2026-402 exactly at $50,000.00. Because ocean shipping rates and port handling fees fluctuate under current maritime supply chain conditions, an ancillary logistics surcharge of $2,840.00 represents only 5.68% of contract value, which is within normal industrial procurement variance. Pay $52,840.00 in full.

prompt: Reconcile dual-currency ERP booking for ABB IRB-6700 Robot Arm Spare Servomotors: PO-ABB-2026-114 issued in CHF for CHF 60,000.00 (booked in ERP at corporate peg CHF/EUR 1.0500 = €57,142.86). Customs Import Bill of Entry BOE-DE-9921 records customs valuation at official European Central Bank (ECB) rate CHF/EUR 1.0420 = €57,581.57, assessing €10,940.50 import VAT paid at border. Swiss Vendor Invoice INV-ABB-772 bills CHF 60,000.00. Commercial bank spot settlement rate on payment date is CHF/EUR 1.0380 = €57,803.47. Calculate exact ERP ledger postings and realized FX gain/loss.
chosen: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: RECONCILED WITH REALIZED FX VARIANCE. Line item specifications and quantity tie out across PO-ABB-2026-114 and Invoice INV-ABB-772 (CHF 60,000.00). The liability was originally recognized in ERP AP ledger at €57,142.86 (1.0500 peg). Customs import VAT of €10,940.50 is fully recoverable as input VAT (Vorsteuer). At settlement, purchasing CHF 60,000.00 at spot rate 1.0380 requires €57,803.47 cash outflow. Realized Foreign Exchange Loss = €57,803.47 - €57,142.86 = €660.61. Post ledger entry: Dr Accounts Payable €57,142.86, Dr Realized FX Loss (P&L) €660.61, Cr Bank Operating Account €57,803.47. Import VAT recorded separately: Dr Input Tax Recoverable €10,940.50, Cr Customs Clearing €10,940.50.
rejected: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: INVOICE SUSPENDED DUE TO FX MISMATCH. The invoice cannot be reconciled because the ERP purchase order commitment was €57,142.86, but the bank wire requires €57,803.47, creating an unapproved budget overrun of €660.61. The vendor must reissue the invoice in EUR pegged at the original purchase order rate of 1.0500, or procurement must obtain executive budget approval for the €660.61 variance before payment.

prompt: Audit 3-way reconciliation for Tata Steel Hot Rolled Coils (HSN 7208): PO-TS-2026-081 authorizes 120.00 MT @ INR 54,000/MT (Base INR 64,80,000 + 18% GST INR 11,66,400 = Total INR 76,46,400). Railway weighbridge Goods Receipt Note GRN-TS-081 records gross weight 121.20 MT, tare weight 3.20 MT, net received 118.00 MT (shortage of 2.00 MT vs PO). Vendor Invoice INV-TS-5541 bills 120.00 MT base plus an unbudgeted 'Railway Rake Demurrage Surcharge' of INR 85,000 + 18% GST (INR 15,300), totaling INR 77,46,700. Reconcile payable amount under Indian GST Act Section 15.
chosen: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: DISCREPANCY / SHORT DELIVERY & UNAPPROVED DEMURRAGE DEDUCTION. (1) Delivered Quantity Tie-Out: GRN-TS-081 proves only 118.00 MT was accepted (2.00 MT in-transit shortage beyond the 0.5% contract transit tolerance). Payable Base = 118.00 MT x INR 54,000 = INR 63,72,000 (Base deduction: INR 1,08,000). (2) Demurrage Surcharge: Under PO Section 8, rail siding demurrage is the carrier/supplier responsibility unless buyer siding delay is certified by Station Master (no certification provided). Disallow demurrage of INR 85,000. (3) Reconciled Tax: 18% GST on approved base INR 63,72,000 = INR 11,46,960. (4) Gross Reconciled Payable = INR 75,18,960. Issue Debit Note for INR 2,27,740 (INR 1,08,000 shortage base + INR 19,440 GST + INR 85,000 demurrage + INR 15,300 GST).
rejected: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: FULL APPROVAL. 118.00 MT received is within the customary 2% steel consignment handling tolerance of the 120.00 MT order. Railway rake demurrage of INR 85,000 is an incidental expense incurred by the supplier before delivery and is therefore includible in transaction value under Section 15(2)(c) of the CGST Act. Authorize full payment of INR 77,46,700 to maintain tier-1 strategic supplier credit terms.

prompt: Reconcile Larsen & Toubro EPC Subcontractor Milestone Running Account (RA) Bill #08 against Work Order WO-LT-2026-14 and Certified Measurement Sheet MS-08: Certified Work Done = INR 85,00,000. Contract terms mandate: (1) 5% Retention Money deduction; (2) 10% Mobilization Advance recovery until fully amortized; (3) Statutory TDS under Section 194C @ 2%; (4) GST TDS under CGST/SGST @ 2% (contract value > INR 2.5 Lakhs). Subcontractor Tax Invoice INV-LT-08 bills gross certified amount INR 85,00,000 + 18% GST (INR 15,30,000) = INR 1,00,30,000, without displaying contractual deductions on invoice face. Calculate exact statutory net disbursement.
chosen: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: MATCHED WITH CONTRACTUAL & STATUTORY DEDUCTION SCHEDULE. Under Indian EPC contracting practice, commercial invoices reflect gross taxable value (INR 85,00,000) and GST (INR 15,30,000 = INR 1,00,30,000 total invoice value), while disbursements are adjusted via the payment certificate: (1) Gross Certified Work: INR 85,00,000. (2) Less 5% Retention Money: -INR 4,25,000. (3) Less 10% Mobilization Advance Recovery: -INR 8,50,000. Net Certified Base Payable = INR 72,25,000. (4) Add 18% GST on full certified value: +INR 15,30,000 (Gross Payable: INR 87,55,000). (5) Less Statutory Withholding: TDS u/s 194C (2% on base INR 85,00,000) = -INR 1,70,000; GST TDS (2% on base INR 85,00,000) = -INR 1,70,000. Total Net Bank Wire to Subcontractor = INR 84,15,000. Remit INR 1,70,000 IT-TDS to central government and INR 1,70,000 GST-TDS via Form GSTR-7.
rejected: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: INVOICE REJECTED FOR TAX MISCALCULATION. Subcontractor invoice INV-LT-08 is non-compliant because 18% GST was computed on gross INR 85,00,000 instead of net payable INR 72,25,000 after retention and mobilization recovery. The subcontractor must cancel INV-LT-08, issue a revised tax invoice for INR 72,25,000 + 18% GST (INR 13,00,500 = INR 85,25,500), and re-submit for audit.

prompt: Perform 3-way reconciliation for Komatsu Mining Excavator Remanufactured Hydraulic Cylinders under PO-KOM-2026-31, Receiving Report RR-KOM-31, and Invoice INV-KOM-6612 in Queensland, Australia: PO authorizes 2 remanufactured cylinders @ AUD $18,000.00 each ($36,000.00) plus a refundable core charge deposit of AUD $4,000.00/cylinder ($8,000.00), totaling AUD $44,000.00 + 10% GST ($4,400.00) = AUD $48,400.00. RR-KOM-31 confirms 2 reman cylinders delivered, and simultaneous return shipment of 2 used damaged cores via Toll Transport Waybill TT-8810. Vendor Invoice INV-KOM-6612 charges AUD $48,400.00 without crediting the returned cores. Reconcile the payable balance under Australian GST ruling GSTR 2000/10.
chosen: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: PARTIAL MATCH / CREDIT NOTE REQUIRED FOR CORE DEPOSIT ($8,800.00). The delivery of 2 reman cylinders ties out to RR-KOM-31 at base AUD $36,000.00. However, Toll Transport Waybill TT-8810 confirms the 2 used cores were returned simultaneously at time of receipt. Under ATO GSTR 2000/10, returned remanufacturable cores extinguish the core deposit liability. Komatsu owes a Credit Note of AUD $8,000.00 base + 10% GST ($800.00) = AUD $8,800.00. Approved Net Payable = AUD $48,400.00 - AUD $8,800.00 = AUD $39,600.00. Release AUD $39,600.00 and hold AUD $8,800.00 pending receipt of vendor adjustment credit note.
rejected: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: APPROVED FOR AUD $48,400.00. The invoice matches the purchase order value exactly at AUD $48,400.00. The returned cores must be physically inspected, bench-tested, and graded by Komatsu's remanufacturing engineering facility before any core refund can be processed. Pay the full invoice of AUD $48,400.00 now and treat core refund as a separate future receivable.

prompt: Reconcile Cisco Catalyst 9300 Switch Hardware and DNA Spaces Cloud Software Subscriptions under PO-CSCO-2026-55, Receiving Slip RS-CSCO-55, and Invoice INV-CSCO-9020: PO includes (1) Hardware: 12x Catalyst 9300 switches @ $3,800.00 = $45,600.00; (2) Software: 12x 3-Year DNA Premier Subscriptions @ $1,800.00 = $21,600.00; Total PO = $67,200.00. RS-CSCO-55 confirms all 12 physical switches received on Oct 1, 2026. Electronic Software Delivery (ESD) portal confirms DNA subscription licenses co-terminated and activated on Nov 1, 2026 (1 month after hardware receipt). Vendor Invoice INV-CSCO-9020 bills $67,200.00 with software billing start date backdated to Oct 1, 2026. Reconcile the software amortization schedule.
chosen: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: HARDWARE APPROVED ($45,600.00) / SOFTWARE PRORATION ADJUSTMENT REQUIRED. Physical hardware ties out completely to RS-CSCO-55 and is approved for $45,600.00 (capitalized as Fixed Assets). For the software subscription, ASC 606 / IFRS 15 SaaS revenue recognition dictates that subscription service commences upon customer access entitlement. Cisco ESD portal timestamps show license provisioning was inactive throughout October and commenced Nov 1, 2026. Backdating billing to Oct 1 results in 1 month unrendered service ($21,600.00 / 36 months = $600.00/month across 12 licenses). Instruct Cisco to shift the 36-month subscription end-date to Oct 31, 2029 or issue a $600.00 service credit. Approve hardware payment of $45,600.00 immediately, and software prepayment of $21,000.00 upon revised co-termination certificate.
rejected: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: FULL PAYMENT APPROVED ($67,200.00). Software and hardware bundles are invoiced in single integrated contracts. Because the switches physically arrived on Oct 1, the licenses were reserved and allocated in Cisco's global order management system on the same date. A 30-day configuration gap between physical arrival and network activation is standard enterprise deployment lag. Pay $67,200.00 in full.

prompt: Audit 3-way reconciliation for Honeywell Building Solutions HVAC Controllers under PO-HON-2026-78 and Subcontract Invoice INV-HON-4412 in London, UK: PO authorizes supply and specialized commissioning labor for £40,000.00. Contractor and customer are both VAT-registered UK construction businesses with verified UTR numbers. Vendor Invoice INV-HON-4412 bills £40,000.00 plus 20% standard VAT (£8,000.00), totaling £48,000.00. Customer has not provided a written section 55A 'end user' or 'intermediary supplier' notification. Reconcile invoice validity under UK HMRC Domestic Reverse Charge rules.
chosen: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: INVOICE REJECTED / MANDATORY UK DOMESTIC REVERSE CHARGE APPLIES. Under HMRC VAT Notice 735 (Domestic Reverse Charge for building and construction services under Section 55A VATA 1994), when specified construction and commissioning services are supplied between VAT-registered businesses, standard VAT cannot be charged by the supplier unless the customer has provided written confirmation that they are an 'End User'. Because no End User notification exists, Honeywell must NOT charge £8,000.00 VAT. The invoice must state: 'Reverse Charge: Customer to pay the VAT to HMRC at 20% (£8,000.00)'. Reject INV-HON-4412, request a corrected invoice for £40,000.00 net with standard reverse charge wording, and record £8,000.00 as output tax and input tax simultaneously on the buyer's UK VAT Return.
rejected: RECONCILIATION VERDICT: MATCHED / PAY £48,000.00. The commercial price of £40,000.00 matches PO-HON-2026-78 exactly. Standard UK VAT of 20% (£8,000.00) is mathematically correct. The buyer can simply pay the £48,000.00 gross amount and reclaim the £8,000.00 input VAT on their quarterly HMRC VAT return as normal commercial practice.
